# ExFu

> ExFu is Alastair Brayne's AI consultancy and agent tooling brand, operated by WhaleyBear Ltd. Fractional and contract work only. Remote engagements preferred; Bristol, UK, in person by arrangement.

## Services and experience
- [Home](https://exfu.ai/): Overview and ways to work together.
- [Fractional AI support](https://exfu.ai/fractional-support/): Opportunity assessment, leadership business cases, agents, integrations and internal ownership. Includes anonymous accounts of travel and EV sector engagements.
- [Personal AI support](https://exfu.ai/personal-support/): Hands-on agent setup around a person's own workload, context and reusable skills.
- [About Alastair](https://exfu.ai/about/): Software and CTO experience, AI startup work, psychotherapy training, and downloadable CVs.
- [Tools](https://exfu.ai/tools/): Documentation and source for the Agent Library, planning and delegating, plan visualiser and humane agents.
- [Enquire](https://exfu.ai/enquire/): Short optional quiz and a human enquiry. Email al@exfu.ai.
- [Open-source tools](https://github.com/exfu/exfu-marketplace): ExFu agent tooling marketplace.

The linked pages contain the full public descriptions. No fixed prices, guaranteed revenue outcomes or clinical services are offered on this site.
